meta.name: fit-scorer
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "score this influencer", "rank these creators for our campaign", or "tell me which influencer is the best fit"; produces the typed STAR Suitability (S) read plus a separately labeled campaign-fit ranking without mixing campaign-specific commercial fit into the Suitability read. Not for finding new influencers — use influencer-discovery; not for sending outreach — use outreach-manager.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估网红与品牌匹配度，自动打分排序
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在策划网红营销活动，需要快速评估候选人匹配度。
copy.tagline_en: Score influencer-brand fit and rank candidates automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're planning an influencer campaign and need to quickly evaluate candidate fit.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会根据你提供的品牌或活动信息，对网红进行五个维度的打分（受众匹配、内容质量、品牌契合、互动真实性、合作潜力），给出加权总分、排名和“推荐/考虑/放弃”的结论，并保存报告。
howto.when: 当你给出一个网红名单，要求“给这个网红打分”、“比较并排名这些创作者”或“告诉我哪个最合适”时触发。

say.text: 给 @ecofashionista 打分，用于我们的可持续时尚品牌。
say.note: Claude 会输出该网红的五维评分和总体推荐结论。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude scores influencers across five dimensions (audience match, content quality, brand alignment, engagement authenticity, partnership potential) based on your brand or campaign, producing weighted totals, a ranked comparison, and a go/pass verdict, then saves the report.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide a shortlist of influencers and ask to "score this influencer", "rank these creators", or "tell me which is the best fit".

say_en.text: Score @ecofashionista for our sustainable fashion brand.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a five-dimension score and overall verdict.
Claude produces a ranked comparison with go/pass for each.
